meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Resend 收发邮件，把邮件线程变成对话。
howto.when: 当用户配置好 Resend API 密钥、发件地址和 Webhook，并运行 /manage-channels 将邮件通道连接到代理组时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 support@example.com 发一封邮件，主题是“问题反馈”。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Resend 发送邮件。

say.text: 检查我的收件箱有没有新邮件。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Webhook 获取新邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive emails via Resend, treating email threads as conversations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user configures Resend API key, from address, and webhook, then runs /manage-channels to connect the email channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Send an email to support@example.com with subject 'Feedback'.
say_en.note: Claude will send the email via Resend.

say_en.text: Check my inbox for new emails.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch new emails via webhook.
